original_metadata.physical_phase_timing_scope: Native event consumes a live original solve; following phase starts on next native timestep. Maximum durations differ from actual executed durations; saved time/state/force never retimestamped.
original_metadata.seat_direction_stop_scope: Actual bolt/female z return50um from a contiguous shallow crest requests only CLOSED robot-yaw deceleration. A150ms C2 curve joins the preceding independent theta/omega/alpha; braking cannot accumulate stopped readiness. Actual max(body,hand) angular and axial quiet plus original100ms impulse/duty/loaded-endpoint AND90/10 bolt-weight support confirm direction before forward. No pitch/groove clock or capture claim.
original_metadata.command_calibration_timing: Measured tool/head target calibration is copied before mj_step from retained previous-solve transforms (time minus2dt after the subsequent step, except initialized first command). Original force observer and its kinematics are from the current native solve at time minusdt. Saved qpos/qvel and explicitly labeled actual jaw aperture are post-integration at time.
original_metadata.native_force_recording_note: mj_step contact forces and contact geometry are from the pre-integration state at recorded time minus timestep; saved qpos/qvel are the post-integration state
original_metadata.left_pad_history_scope: Every physics substep after end-settle stabilization acquisition; separately from 5 ms saved-pose sampling

robot_yaw_brake.scope: Pure independent scheduled robot theta/omega/alpha, whole-curve reverse/workspace/speed validation; native tracking remains separately guarded.

robot_inertia_feedforward.scope: Approximate retained native6-arm-DOF M_aa with fingers at actual configuration; downstream finger rigid inertia included, independent finger acceleration/coupled contacts not inverted. Five instantaneous WORLD acceleration projections, no axial inversion/position/lead row. Active only CLOSED head feedback with axial force-float; disabled during pickup/transport/OPEN/regrasp.
robot_inertia_feedforward.command_velocity_timing: Separate arm qvel copy captured immediately before previous mj_step coheres with retained M/J/Jdot/cvel/bias. Right PD damping and native drag use this copy in all phases. First command uses normal initialized fresh state, no qvel overwrite. Left/base controller unchanged.
robot_inertia_feedforward.desired_acceleration_scope: Independent head clock alpha and orbital acceleration -alpha cross lever-omega cross(omega cross lever). Current hole basis frozen instantaneously; hole acceleration and measured calibration derivatives omitted. No groove/pitch input.
robot_inertia_feedforward.caps: Total PD+FF with axial feed inside original8N/2Nm before mapping; bias and drag once, then unchanged native motor clips.

numerical_condition_limits.scope: Finite/SPD/full-rank rejection, no regularization; numerical SI bounds, not physical singularity certificate.

original_metadata.support_force_timing: mj_step contact forces and contact geometry are from the pre-integration state at recorded time minus timestep; saved qpos/qvel are the post-integration state

pad_contact_compliance_observation.scope: Native signed distances and solved forces at acquisition end-settle; effective force/indentation is a model observation, not material modulus or hardware calibration

table_load_window.scope: No-bolt settled stabilization: original native table force bears block weight; contact candidates alone do not establish support

archived_model_identity.method: Compile exact SHA-verified archived XML/assets with explicit already-built plugin. No current scene generation/plugin build/forward/collision/integration.

original_command_norms.scope: Norms of ORIGINAL executed robot command records, not measured thread/contact forces or replay forces

original_force_state_timing: Force/retained native geometry t−50µs; post-qpos/qvel t; actual ORIGINAL retained command timestamp archived separately, initialized exceptions retained. Disabled inverse/Jdot presence remains explicit. No replay forces.
